text: The hour of Pradosha, between day and night, is traditionally seen as a time when what feels unsettled within us can be gently set down.
On this day, we remember Shiva as the one who helps us carry burdens too heavy for us alone.
You are invited to offer an abhishekam with water or milk, or simply light a deepam before a picture of Shiva.
Chant 'Om Namah Shivaya' for as long as it feels natural.
If you have Bilva leaves, you may offer them; know that a simple deepam alone is no less of a complete puja.
